ev.q: a total of 967,615 nonfatal drug overdoses were treated in EDs, an increase of 4.3% from 2016
In 2017, there were 967,615 nonfatal drug overdose ED visits (300.2 per 100,000 population)
In 2017, there were 967,615 nonfatal drug overdose ED visits (300.2 per 100,000 population)
From 2016 to 2017, the nonfatal overdose rates for all drug types increased significantly except for those involving benzodiazepines.
All rates, except age group, were age-adjusted.
Hospital discharge data represent the reference standard in nonfatal overdose surveillance
Absolute and relative rate changes were calculated from 2016 to 2017 by patient, facility, and visit characteristics

methods_quotes.q: z-tests were used to compare changes that occurred from 2016 to 2017 and for pairwise comparisons between groups for 2017 rates
All rates, except age group, were age-adjusted.
Age-adjusted rates were calculated using the 2000 U.S. Census standard population age distribution.
Relative change is the absolute rate change divided by the 2016 rate, multiplied by 100.
Analyses were conducted using SAS (version 9.4; SAS Institute) to account for HCUP’s complex survey design and weighting.
